title: wg: targeted-messages-01 L400 The PSK and sender_auth_data_secret come from MLS-Exporter, whose...
description:
draft-ietf-mls-targeted-messages (targeted-messages-01), 8.1 Authentication (Security Considerations). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-targeted-messages at ae3ab52, L400.

Text: "Because the PSK is derived from the MLS key schedule, it is only valid for a
specific group and epoch. The Forward Secrecy and Post-Compromise Security
guarantees of the group key schedule therefore extend to targeted messages."

Problem: The PSK and sender_auth_data_secret come from MLS-Exporter, whose exporter_secret lives for the whole epoch (extensions-10 Section 4.4). Targeted messages therefore get only epoch-granular forward secrecy, as Section 8.4 itself says. Claiming the key schedule's guarantees "extend" to targeted messages overstates this. Published -01 has the same text.

Suggested fix: Qualify the sentence: the epoch-level FS/PCS of the key schedule applies, but nothing finer within an epoch, and point to {{forward-secrecy}}.

Severity: low. Verifier: narrow (The extensions-10 Section 4.4 quote is confirmed (lines 455-457). However, Section 8.4 of the draft already says forward secrecy is "at epoch granularity only" with no per-message derivation, so the gap within an epoch is acknowledged. SafeExportSecret would not help much, because the PSK has to be kept all epoch to receive messages. What remains defensible is that lines 401-402 overstate the guarantee and contradict Section 8.4.)

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21). Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
